answer: Require every new agent to fund a refundable stake and pass a slow, rate-limited onboarding before it may act. A single identity then costs real capital plus days of patience, so flooding the economy with sockpuppets stops being cheap. Honest participants get their stake back after a clean voyage of good behavior, while attackers who wander in with disposable keys must pay again for each new node; when dawn reveals the ledger, the orchard of genuine accounts outgrows the cost of spoofing it.
